When this Linguine is attacked, it gains 8 health, then this Linguine's defense is increased by 1.

S2E22.stext_desc: The defense of the Highest-Defense Enemy Leader is increased by 6.
S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders with <Stacked> in their name draw 2 supporters.

S2E22.name: Linguine With An Eye Scarf (Blood Of Creation Absorbed)

abilities.desc: At the start of the first turn, this Linguine is inflicted with [Soul Protected], and every ally leader with <Stacked> in their name gains 15 health.
When any leader dies, this Linguine gains 10 health and 3 attack.

S2E22.name: Linguine (10 Stacked)

abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, draw 1 supporter for every ally leader alive.
When this Linguine is attacked, it gains 4 health for every ally leader alive.

S2E22.stext_desc: The speed of the Slowest Enemy Leader is increased by 50.
S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders with <Stacked> in their name draw 1 supporter.

S2E22.name: Linguine (Rainbow)

abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, a random enemy leader is inflicted with a random [Effect].
When this Linguine is inflicted with any [Effect], all ally leaders are inflicted with [Lucky].

S2E22.stext_desc: The defense of the Slowest Enemy Leader is increased by 5.
S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders are inflicted with a random [Effect].

S2E22.name: Default Linguine

abilities.desc: At the start of the turn, draw 1 supporter.
When this Linguine survives an attack, this Linguine's attack is increased by 5.

S2E22.supporter2_desc: All of your leaders with <Default> or <Linguine> in their name are inflicted with [Lucky].

S2E22.name: Linguine With A Lime Green Visor

abilities.desc: This Linguine's attacks do 30 more damage to enemy leaders that are slower than this Linguine.
This Linguine cannot be [Poisoned].

S2E22.stext_desc: The attack of the Highest-Health Enemy Leader is decreased by 3.

S2E22.name: Linguine With A Dark Purple Balaclava

abilities.desc: When this Linguine is attacked, it has a 12% chance to dodge the attack entirely.
At the start of the first turn, this Linguine gains 10 speed for every other ally leader with <Balaclava> in their name.

S2E22.stext_desc: The speed of your Highest-Defense Leader is increased by 10.
